summary.text: Randy Novak is a Democratic state representative from Indiana House District 9 who has represented the district since October 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He was appointed to the seat in 2025 to replace Patricia Boy and is a real estate broker.
The other candidate on the general election ballot is Chris Cleveland, the Republican nominee.

paragraphs.text: Novak was appointed to the House District 9 seat by a Democratic precinct committee on October 18, 2025, to replace Patricia Boy, and took office on October 22, 2025.
His career experience includes working as a real estate broker.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Novak said he spent more than 33 years with the Michigan City Fire Department, eventually serving as fire chief, and later served as president of the LaPorte County Council, and that he has worked for more than 28 years as a licensed real estate broker.
He said his priorities include affordability, workforce housing, good-paying jobs, public safety capacity, and mental health and addiction services.
